notebooks.official_information_policy: SODIR and Norwegianpetroleum definitions are paraphrased from official sources accessed 22 August 2026. Live SODIR retrieval is disabled in the retained run. All project, fluid, composition, volume, rate, capacity, marketability, price, cost, schedule, and economic values are explicitly synthetic teaching inputs. The notebook instructs readers to re-check current controlling guidance and responsible licence evidence before formal use.
known_limitations: The notebook does not make or audit a formal resource-classification decision and is not an RNB submission or reserves opinion.

The synthetic SRK process omits calibrated PVT, compositional variation, wells and SURF, dehydration, acid-gas removal, dew-point control, NGL recovery, detailed stabilization, product specifications, metering, availability, emissions, controls, and dynamics.
The marketability factors and facility capacity are teaching assumptions, not host guarantees, transport rights, tariffs, allocation rules, or commercial terms.
The educational probability distributions omit governed correlations, model-form uncertainty, bias, multi-project aggregation, and confidential evidence.
The economic screen is pre-tax and omits financing, detailed tariffs and processing charges, emissions cost, abandonment, reliability, and commercial allocation.
Retained outputs use NeqSim 3.17.0; the normal Colab source-build path for current master is present but was not the controlled output runtime.
notebooks.documentation_impact: Adds one advanced field-development entry to the main NeqSim-Colab catalog, eight relative companion-notebook links inside the notebook, and a dedicated maintenance shard. No NeqSim Java or Python API, numerical behavior, installation default, or model recommendation changed.
notebooks.issue_handling: No NeqSim defect or distinct actionable Java/Python API gap was exposed by the clean execution, so no equinor/neqsim issue was opened.
